objective: A thin, human-facing CLI binary, supervisor-cli, that lets an engineer run any of the six SupervisorQuery types against a real device from a terminal.

acceptance.criterion: supervisor-cli parses subcommands into SupervisorQuery variants and applies defaults.
supervisor-cli executes queries through QueryBackend, applying validation and clamping before printing JSON.
acceptance.verification: Cargo test run module in hydragrow-supervisor-cli

acceptance.criterion: supervisor-cli main binary wires HttpQueryBackend and exits with code 1 on query errors.
